title: Trainee teachers’ sit-in at the Education Ministry
reason: CIVICUS reports a dozen trainee teachers at the sit-in; this is an actual State-directed protest but below the 50-participant threshold.
notes: A security guard’s shooting of a passerby and later justice march are separate events.

title: Anti-insecurity demonstration described on a misleading August-dated iMedia page
reason: Although the page displays an Aug 15 date, the body explicitly identifies the demonstration as April 2, 2025; it falls outside the July–September quarter and is not August evidence.
notes: Do not attribute its reported attendance, slogans or police response to August.
